description: Render one DataCite DOI as a formatted citation in a CSL style and locale (APA in US English by default), or as a machine-readable record: CSL JSON, BibTeX, RIS, DataCite JSON or XML, Schema.org JSON-LD, Codemeta, or JATS. A style the upstream renderer does not support — an unknown id or a dependent journal style — is rejected instead of silently rendered as APA. Formatted text comes back as plain text alongside the upstream HTML markup. A long document comes back one slice at a time: limit sets the slice size in UTF-16 units (default 100,000) and nextOffset continues it. A DOI DataCite does not hold returns found: false naming the registration agency that does.

doi.description: The DataCite DOI, e.g. 10.5061/dryad.234. Accepted bare, with doi: or info:doi/ prefixes, as a doi.org / dx.doi.org URL, or %2F-encoded; case-insensitive.

format.description: text (formatted citation, default), csl_json, bibtex, ris, datacite_json, datacite_xml, schema_org, codemeta, or jats.

limit.description: UTF-16 code units of the document per slice (for text, of the upstream HTML), a positive integer (default 100,000). A slice ends early rather than split a surrogate pair, or for text a tag or character reference, and runs past limit only when one such unit alone is longer. Values above 1,000,000 apply 1,000,000 with a notice unless strict limits are configured.

locale.description: CSL locale for format text, e.g. en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, or a bare language (de → de-DE); any case. Omitted: en-US. List: datacite_list_reference topic citation_locales.

offset.description: Zero-based offset, in UTF-16 code units, where the slice starts (for text, into the upstream HTML); default 0. An offset inside a surrogate pair, or for text inside a tag or character reference, starts the slice at that unit's start. Pass nextOffset to continue. At or past the end the slice is empty.

style.description: CSL style id for format text, e.g. apa (default), ieee, chicago-author-date, modern-language-association, vancouver, nature. Lowercased. A style that would silently fall back to APA is rejected. Verified ids: datacite_list_reference topic citation_styles.

name: datacite_get_citation

cap.description: The limit applied, in UTF-16 code units.

citation.description: text: the citation as plain text (tags stripped, entities decoded) of the HTML in citationHtml; each slice is converted on its own, so join citationHtml slices, not these, to rebuild a paged text document. Machine formats: the document verbatim, or the slice of it offset and limit select, never splitting a surrogate pair; slices joined in offset order reproduce it exactly. Empty when offset is at or past the end.

citationHtml.description: text only: the upstream HTML markup verbatim (<i>, &, small caps): the whole rendering trimmed, or the exact slice offset and limit select, which never ends inside a tag or character reference.

downloadUrl.description: Exact negotiated URL for the whole document, returned with a slice short of it; fetch it to retrieve the document in one response.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_doi`: The doi input is not a DOI after normalization. `unsupported_style`: The style check finds the upstream rendering the default APA output instead of the requested non-APA style (unknown id, dependent journal style, retired id). `unsupported_locale`: locale is not a CSL locale DataCite renders (CSL locales tl-PH and hy-AM render as APA in US English). `style_requires_text`: style or locale set with a machine format. `format_unavailable`: DataCite cannot render this DOI in the requested format: it answers HTTP 204, HTTP 200 with an empty body, or HTTP 400. `render_failed`: DataCite answered HTTP 5xx on every attempt; a renderer fault on this record and a brief outage give the same status. `rate_limited`: This deployment's shared DataCite request budget is spent: its request queue could not start a request before the call's deadline, or DataCite answered HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when DataCite holds the DOI and rendered it; false when it holds no public record (the miss fields explain).

guidance.description: The next step for this miss. Miss arm only.

locale.description: CSL locale applied (text only; absent means en-US).

missReason.description: Why DataCite holds no public record: another agency registered it, no agency did, it is a DataCite DOI without public (Findable) metadata, or the agency lookup did not answer. Miss arm only.

nextOffset.description: Where the next slice starts: call again with the same doi, format, style, locale, and limit, and this as offset. Absent once a slice reaches the end.

notice.description: Set when the style could not be confirmed as distinct from APA, JATS contains empty names or inconsistent years, a limit over 1,000,000 was applied as 1,000,000, or citation is a slice of the document (its range and the call that continues it).

registrationAgency.description: Registration agency that holds the DOI (e.g. Crossref, mEDRA, DataCite), when known. Miss arm only.

shown.description: UTF-16 code units in this slice (for text, of the HTML in citationHtml).

totalCharacters.description: Length of the whole document in UTF-16 code units (for text, of the upstream HTML), returned with a slice short of it.

truncated.description: True when citation is a slice short of the whole document: units remain past it (nextOffset), or offset starts it past the beginning.

title: Get DataCite citation
